latest.title: President of the European Central Bank Christine Lagarde to step down. Here's who is tipped to replace her
latest.description: European Central Bank President Christine Lagarde will step down on Feb. 7 next year, she announced Thursday.

latest.title: DoorDash to acquire Instacart for $17 billion
latest.description: The deal unites two delivery giants under one roof, with DoorDash's focus on restaurants and Instacart's robust stable of grocery partners.

latest.title: Polygon Extends Its Stablecoin Payments Infrastructure to Solana
latest.description: The expansion gives Solana businesses one integration to connect bank funding, embedded wallets, cross-chain transfers and global payouts, with cross-border firm Kira among the first adopters.

latest.title: Polygon expands Open Money Stack to Solana, after Tron rollout
latest.description: The move follows the addition of Tron support and Polygon’s acquisition of Coinme.

latest.title: Justin Sun's HTX Agrees to Leave UK in Settlement With Financial Watchdog
latest.description: The FCA says the Justin Sun-linked exchange will no longer target UK consumers, ending its first case against a crypto firm over marketing.

latest.title: A new framework for tokenized asset tracking
latest.description: None of the numbers most commonly used to assess tokenized assets answer the question a chief investment officer would ask about those assets on her own balance sheet: what is it doing for me?

latest.title: Tokenized stock venue on Canton could beat OKX–ICE to first trade under SEC framework
latest.description: The venue, called TSV LLC, plans to start trading shares Canton Strategic Holdings shares as early as Monday, using issuer-sponsored tokenization that avoids the 30-day company objection window.

latest.title: Analysis: Kevin Warsh is keeping his options open — and Wall Street guessing
latest.description: The new chairman made clear he leans toward higher interest rates, but left himself options depending on how the data comes in.

latest.title: Chainalysis traces North Korean crypto cash-outs through Garantex
latest.description: The analysis followed US sanctions against 10 people and one entity accused of helping North Korean IT worker schemes fund weapons programs.

latest.title: Morning Minute: Hedge Funds Left the BTC ETF Trade and Sovereign Wealth Stepped In

latest.title: HTX agrees to halt unlawful UK crypto promotions after FCA case
latest.description: HTX has pledged to stop crypto marketing in the UK until October 2031, with deposits and new account registrations already blocked there.

latest.title: U.S. sanctions Russian nationals for laundering millions in crypto for North Korean IT workers
latest.description: Russian nationals Ilya Boykov and Vitold Obertas allegedly converted about $3.5 million and nearly $2 million in crypto, respectively, for North Korea.

latest.title: AI build-out hits snag as Google and Microsoft put off raising capex forecasts
latest.description: Microsoft and Alphabet both reported capital expenditures that fell short of estimates, adding to concern over the cost of the AI build-out.

latest.title: Alphabet earnings miss reflects first real sign that AI is taking a bite out of search
